entities.name: Obliteration of Tolaria
entities.description: Event in 4205 AR in which Barrin destroyed Tolaria during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Great mage, master of the Tolarian Academy and ally of Urza, who destroyed Tolaria in grief.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Barrin's daughter, who died of the Phyrexian plague.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Hanna's mother, entombed in a crypt on Tolaria.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Barrin's ally who recalled him to Koilos and never told him Hanna was dying.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Island home of the Tolarian Academy, destroyed by Barrin.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Dominaria during which Tolaria was destroyed.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Place Barrin was recalled to by Urza.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Front line where Barrin was fighting.

events.summary: Recalled to Koilos by Urza, Barrin learns that his daughter Hanna died of the Phyrexian plague and Urza never told him.
events.quote: she had died from the Phyrexian plague

events.summary: Barrin recovers Hanna's body and returns to Tolaria, finding it overrun by Phyrexians.
events.quote: Barrin recovered Hanna's body and returned to Tolaria

events.summary: Barrin places Hanna in the tomb of her mother Rayne and draws on mana from five lands to become a living sylex.
events.quote: He became a vessel of pure destruction, a living sylex .

events.summary: Barrin's spell incinerates Phyrexian warships and annihilates every living thing on the island, which sinks beneath the waves.
events.quote: The island cracked and sank beneath the waves

events.summary: Barrin perishes in the blast; only Rayne and Hanna in their sarcophagi remain untouched.
events.quote: Barrin himself perished in the blast, his mortal form consumed by the magnitude of his magic.

relations.quote: in the hope of reuniting with his daughter, Hanna
Barrin, long a trusted ally of Urza and master of the Academy

relations.note: His spell annihilated Phyrexians on Tolaria.
relations.quote: every living thing — Phyrexian and Tolarian alike — was annihilated in a flash of arcane fire
